label: Global interface history
title: Do two lags recover enough information globally when radius two still fails?
summary: The frozen touching-strip representation remains globally conflicting in 183 of 192 tested finite-ring cells, but full P15 with two lags on D2 is globally deterministic on both rings 6 and 7 even though every accepted local radius through two conflicts. All nine global passes occur at D2,h=2.
takeaway: For the full two-lag interface state on the tested rings, the missing predictive information is present somewhere in the complete ring field; the unresolved resource is locality radius, not representation-level information loss. This is a finite-ring result only.
